title: Startup chooses an older snapshot after revision numbers reach two digits
description: Startup chooses an older snapshot after revision numbers reach two digits
taskPrompt: Startup selects the newest snapshot correctly for earlier revisions, but after the repository reached two-digit revision numbers it can load an older snapshot even though the new file is present. expectedBehavior: Agent completes the requested behavior and passes independent hidden validation
